description:
6/7 bedroom residence extending to c.4,185 sq. ft.

Raymond Potterton & Co. are proud to present “Oaklands”, a truly impressive B3-rated detached 6/7 bedroom residence extending to approximately 4,185 sq. ft., offering a superb balance of space, style and modern efficiency, finished to an outstanding standard throughout no stone has been left unturned in this large family home.

From the moment you arrive, the property makes a striking impression, with electric gates opening onto a beautifully presented setting.

Internally you a introduced to the home by a grand entrance that immediately sets the tone for the quality and space within, combining generous proportions, high specification and a wonderful sense of light and space, all within a private and highly desirable setting.

The heart of the home is a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and living space, designed with modern family living in mind. Flooded with natural light from expansive glazing and skylights, this area seamlessly connects to the gardens and patio spaces, creating an ideal environment for both everyday life and entertaining.

Complementing this are multiple reception rooms, including a warm and inviting formal lounge with feature fireplace, a separate living room, and a dedicated games/snooker room, offering exceptional versatility for a growing family.

he accommodation is equally impressive, with generously proportioned bedrooms throughout, each beautifully presented and filled with natural light.  The principal bedroom provides a calm and spacious retreat with full size ensuite bathroom and separate dressing room, while additional rooms offer flexibility for family with three more of the double rooms been ensuite.

Externally, the property continues to impress with landscaped gardens, two patio areas and a large detached garage with additional storage.

A host of modern features including a wired EV charging point, mains gas heating, high-quality windows, composite front door, outdoor lighting and a fully alarmed security system ensure both comfort and convenience.  Ideally located between the popular towns of Dunshaughlin and Ratoath, this home enjoys the best of both worlds - a peaceful countryside setting with excellent accessibility.

Both towns offer a wide range of amenities including excellent schools, shops, restaurants and sporting facilities. For leisure enthusiasts, the property is also within easy reach of the prestigious Killeen Castle and Black Bush Golf Clubs.  The nearby M3 and M2 motorways provide a convenient commute to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas

This is a turnkey home of real distinction, combining generous proportions, high specification and a wonderful sense of light and space, all within a private and highly desirable setting. This property is sure to be very popular as it’s a stunning family home ready to go and early viewing is advised Accommodation includes Entrance Hall, Lounge, Reception Room, Games Room, Kitchen/Dining/Living Area, Utility Room, Laundry Room, 6 Bedrooms (4 ensuites) and Bathroom.
